surface: RepoRoast client (client/src) -- landing, loading, result dashboard, Custom Mode

findings.title: Stranger test borderline-passes, swap test fails
findings.principle: Lean UX -- hypothesis must be visible in the surface
findings.evidence: First screen names the product and the action, but the subcopy would read true for almost any AI code-review competitor if the name were swapped.
findings.fix: Put the one real differentiator (local static analysis + weighted scoring, not just an LLM opinion) into the headline or sub-line itself.

findings.title: Repo URL input has no visible label, only a placeholder
findings.evidence: UrlInput.tsx:45 -- the <input> has no <label>, only a placeholder. Once focused and typed into, the field's purpose disappears.
findings.fix: Add a visually-hidden <label htmlFor="repo-url-input"> so the field's purpose survives focus, screen readers, and autofill.

findings.title: Nine buttons across the app have no explicit type attribute
findings.principle: Norman -- mental models; a <button> inside a <form> defaults to type=submit
findings.evidence: CategorySection.tsx:28, CustomModeModal.tsx:63/81/134, ReviewDashboard.tsx:109, StaticAnalysisPanel.tsx:22, UrlInput.tsx:70/79/88 all missing type="button".
findings.fix: Add type="button" to every non-submit button.

findings.title: Three pages size their root container with 100vh and no dvh fallback
findings.principle: Krug -- the squint test must survive the real device
findings.evidence: App.tsx:79, ErrorBoundary.tsx:22, ResultPage.tsx:57 use 100vh-based classes; mobile browser chrome show/hide will clip or gap the layout.
findings.fix: Use min-h-[100dvh] with a min-h-screen fallback on these three root containers.

findings.title: Hero headline is the default three-breakpoint AI hero stack
findings.principle: Krug -- self-evidence should come from what the copy needs, not a template default
findings.evidence: Hero.tsx:84 -- text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl on a six-word headline that doesn't need three escalating steps.
findings.fix: Collapse to two sizes sized to the actual string length.

findings.title: Three cards combine a 1px border with a heavy drop shadow
findings.principle: Gestalt -- one depth cue per element
findings.evidence: ScoreCard.tsx:29, ReviewDashboard.tsx:59/76, UrlInput.tsx:41 all pair a border with a heavy shadow.
findings.fix: Pick one per surface -- border for flat content panels, shadow only for genuinely floating elements.

findings.title: Render-blocking @import chain in the global stylesheet
findings.principle: Doherty threshold -- UI should respond inside ~400ms
findings.evidence: index.css:1-3 -- three @import statements for Tailwind layers loaded sequentially before first paint.
findings.fix: Confirm the production bundle doesn't ship a blocking import chain (Vite inlines these at build time); downgrade to Cosmetic if it's dev-only.

findings.title: mixBlendMode set via inline style when a Tailwind utility exists
findings.principle: Consistency -- one styling mechanism, not two
findings.evidence: HomePage.tsx:139 -- style={{ mixBlendMode: 'screen' }} where className="mix-blend-screen" would do the same thing.
findings.fix: Swap to the Tailwind utility class.

findings.title: Footer sign-off breaks the voice built everywhere else
findings.evidence: Footer.tsx -- "Built with brains and AI by Justin Varghese" sits next to terminal-style tags and sentence-case labels built this session.
findings.fix: Rewrite in the same blunt register, or cut it -- the navbar's GitHub link already credits authorship.

findings.title: Two inline SVGs (score rings) have no aria-label or aria-hidden
findings.principle: WCAG / Norman -- meaningful graphics need a text alternative, decorative ones need hiding
findings.evidence: Hero.tsx:41, ScoreCard.tsx:33 -- both render a circular progress SVG exposed to assistive tech with no label.
findings.fix: Add aria-hidden="true" (since the score is already announced via adjacent text) or role="img" aria-label="Score: N out of 100".

findings.title: Splash screen uses an arbitrary z-[9999]
findings.principle: Consistency -- an undisciplined z-index scale makes stacking bugs hard to reason about
findings.evidence: SplashScreen.tsx:8 -- z-[9999] vs LoadingScreen's z-[999], one order of magnitude different for similar full-screen overlays.
findings.fix: Normalize to a small app-wide z-index scale instead of magic numbers.

strategic_moves: Give the URL input a real (visually-hidden) label -- the one control the product hinges on has no accessible name once focused.
Fix the three 100vh-without-dvh containers before the mobile audience hits address-bar clipping.
Resolving the border+shadow duplication across cards IS the glass-panel material split from the critique -- one pass fixes both.
